title: Verify data lineage is reported correctly for a single data source
gherkin:
Feature: Data Lineage Reporting
  Scenario: Report lineage for a single data source
    Given I have a data source with ID "DS1"
    When I request the data lineage report for "DS1"
    Then the report should include the source ID "DS1" and its transformations
rationale: To ensure that the system can accurately report the lineage of a single data source, confirming that the source ID and transformations are correctly captured.
